name: The Mark of Quality
summary: In Camp Mojache, the leatherworker Jangdor Swiftstrider holds that quality should never be compromised. Jangdor has found thick yeti hides and wants a stack of ten.

sections.title: A Matter of Pride
sections.body: Jangdor Swiftstrider takes pride in leatherwork and says quality should never be compromised. Lately Jangdor has discovered thick yeti hides. Feralas is home to the yetis, and they are often found west of Camp Mojache in Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.

sections.title: The Offer
sections.body: For a stack of ten hides, Jangdor will let you choose one of the leather goods Jangdor has made. Bring them back to Camp Mojache.

sections.title: Jangdor's Thoughts on the Hides
sections.body: Jangdor declares that, given a special treatment, the hides hold up as well as iron. Finding the right tanning mix will take many attempts, yet Jangdor is sure the hides will raise the mark of quality higher than before.

faq.q: Who is asking for the hides?
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider, a leatherworker at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

faq.q: Where can the yetis be found?
faq.answer: Yetis are native to Feralas. Many are found to the west of Camp Mojache in Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.
Ten of them, as one stack.

faq.q: What do I get for the hides?
faq.answer: Jangdor offers a choice among the leather goods Jangdor has made, in exchange for the stack.
